edits.after: - Fizz Playful/Trickster: 16s at rank 1, 8 at max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; bait it before spending your burst. - His R shark is 120s and your 2-second pool dodges it. - Your 28s Sanguine Pool has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. The R, the moment it goes right.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
